title: NVIDIA Riva gRPC API Missing Authentication for Critical Function Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of NVIDIA Riva. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the riva_quickstart component. The issue results from the lack of authentication prior to allowing access to functionality. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass authentication on the system.
